threads.body: The new guidance is a bit ambiguous/contradictory: it says “Do not comment on … imports” and “brace placement”, which could be interpreted as suppressing import- or brace-related correctness findings (e.g., unused imports that break compilation, missing/unbalanced braces). Consider tightening wording to explicitly scope this to Spotless-only concerns (import ordering/grouping/unused removal, brace *style*), while still allowing comments on import/brace issues that affect correctness/buildability.
